name: @mario.andreschak/mcp-filesystem

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read text or media files. Use "path" for one file or "paths" for up to 25; do not use both. For text, "from"/"to" select lines and "pattern" is a case-insensitive regular expression. Regex metacharacters have their usual meaning and must be escaped for literal matching; invalid expressions or expressions over 4096 characters return an error. Files over 100 KB need a line range or pattern; the exact pattern "*" is a reserved sentinel that reads the whole file. Media limit: 32 MB. Use the returned contentHash as expectedHash when editing.

path.description: File or directory path. Relative paths start at the FLUJO data directory.

paths.description: File paths to read in input order. Mutually exclusive with "path".

pattern.description: Case-insensitive regular expression, limited to 4096 characters. Regex metacharacters have their usual meaning; escape them for a literal match. Invalid or over-limit expressions return a tool error. Required to read a large file whole without a "from"/"to" range; matching lines plus context are returned instead of the full body. The exact value "*" is reserved to read the whole file.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write a text file and create missing parent directories. Modes: overwrite (default), append, or insert before startLine. For a range overwrite, give startLine and endLine. Use expectedHash from read_file to reject changes to a stale file; it is ignored for whole-file overwrite.

path.description: File or directory path. Relative paths start at the FLUJO data directory.

startLine.description: For "insert": line to insert before. For "overwrite": first line of the range to replace (1-based).

endLine.description: For "overwrite": last line (inclusive, 1-based) of the range to replace.

expectedHash.description: Optional SHA-256 (contentHash from read_file). For append/insert/range-overwrite modes, the write is rejected if the file no longer hashes to this value (TOCTOU guard).

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Edit a text file with either "edits" or "diff"; do not use both. Each oldText must match once, so include enough context to make it unique. A unified diff is applied atomically. Use expectedHash from read_file to reject edits to a stale file.

path.description: File or directory path. Relative paths start at the FLUJO data directory.

edits.description: List of literal { oldText, newText } edits applied in order (optionally scoped with startLine/endLine).

startLine.description: Optional 1-based first line to scope this edit to.

endLine.description: Optional 1-based last line (inclusive) to scope this edit to.

diff.description: A unified diff to apply atomically. Mutually exclusive with "edits".

startLine.description: Optional default 1-based first line to scope all literal edits to.

endLine.description: Optional default 1-based last line (inclusive) to scope all literal edits to.

expectedHash.description: Optional SHA-256 (contentHash from read_file). If provided and the freshly-read file no longer hashes to it, the edit is rejected with no changes written (TOCTOU guard).

tools.name: list_dir
tools.description: List a directory. Each entry includes name, type, and size.

path.description: File or directory path. Relative paths start at the FLUJO data directory.

tools.name: file_browser_ui
tools.description: Ask the user to pick a file in an interactive browser. This returns before they choose. After calling it, STOP and wait for a follow-up user message containing the selected path.

path.description: Optional starting directory for the browser (defaults to the FLUJO data directory).

tools.name: dir_tree
tools.description: List a directory tree recursively, limited by depth.

path.description: File or directory path. Relative paths start at the FLUJO data directory.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search a directory tree by namePattern and/or text content. Matching is case-insensitive. Content matches include line numbers. Binary and very large files are skipped.

path.description: File or directory path. Relative paths start at the FLUJO data directory.

namePattern.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to match against entry names.

content.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to match inside text files.

tools.name: get_file_info
tools.description: Get a path's type, size, and creation and modification times.

path.description: File or directory path. Relative paths start at the FLUJO data directory.

tools.name: create_directory
tools.description: Create a directory and any missing parents. Succeeds if it exists.

path.description: File or directory path. Relative paths start at the FLUJO data directory.

tools.name: move
tools.description: Move or rename a file or directory.

tools.name: delete
tools.description: Delete a file or directory. Set recursive to true for a non-empty directory.

path.description: File or directory path. Relative paths start at the FLUJO data directory.

recursive.description: Remove directories and their contents recursively.

tools.name: get_allowed_directories
tools.description: List the directories this server is allowed to access.
